free_tier.stated: New accounts start with USD 5 in credit shared across the account's keys and usage. After it runs out, requests draw from prepaid credit topped up in the console.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an inference endpoint stores nothing for the caller

egress.terms: the response is the payload; no separate egress term is published

tooling: an OpenAI-compatible base URL with an account API key; no Hopper package is needed
chaining: the one-off USD 5 signup credit and the prepaid top-up after it bind the offer

limits.value: USD 5 credit on signup, shared across keys; prepaid top-up afterwards

identity_cost.detail: sign up or sign in at withhopper.com/console/keys and create an API key

reliability_note: on 402 the account needs credit; on 429 the caller must honor Retry-After; the test request is a one-off check, not a speed benchmark

evidence.proved: new accounts start with USD 5 in shared credit; a signup and key are required and further use draws from prepaid credit
evidence.quote:
New accounts start with **$5 in
credit**, shared across the account's keys and usage.

notes: the only free allowance is a USD 5 signup credit shared across keys, after which usage is prepaid
